title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash cf0b50b8b7a8… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash cf0b50b8b7a861c3490889683d857e50b54d0e4975678d58778bba800b589db8 was observed twice on 2026-11-07 by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors. The file is associated with attacker activity involving the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer). The malicious payload could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. The attacker infrastructure was traced to Poland and Romania. This indicator should be matched against files in environments and security tools to detect potential compromise.
